# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the iterative RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes one complete TDD cycle (RED→GREEN→REFACTOR) with retry logic |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Language-specific pod for Python TDD cycles, delegates to WorkerAgent and PodmanOrchestrator |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase (test, implementation, refactor) using LLM |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment to write |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer for isolated container runs |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, semantic deduplication, and persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments with PostgreSQL/SQLite fallback |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into actionable playbook updates |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.) |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| BulletClusterer | src/playbook/clustering.py | DBSCAN-based clustering for playbook bullets |
| BulletDeduplicator | src/playbook/deduplication.py | Semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Validates generated code against forbidden imports and builtins |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST-based context maps for code generation guidance |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec objects |
| PlaybookEnforcer | src/agents/playbook_enforcer.py | Enforces high-frequency feedback rules on edits |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records TDD failures and interventions for self-improvement |
| TDDLessonInjector | src/agents/tdd_lesson_injector.py | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts based on development phase |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED phase |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Anonymous agent capability tracking |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator.py | Measures experiment success rates across the system |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency.py | Computes token efficiency scores from LanguagePod run data |
| PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer | src/reliability/playbook_analyzer.py | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN outcomes |
| TDDCycleAnalyzer | src/reliability/tdd_cycle_analyzer.py | Measures first-pass GREEN rate and trend over time |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as run_cycle.py
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    Main->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_file)
    Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
    Planner->>LLM: generate(prompt)
    LLM-->>Planner: test_increment
    Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement

    loop for each cycle
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Worker: test_code
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult(passed=False)
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result

        alt RED aborted
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
        else RED passed
            loop up to max_green_attempts
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error)
                Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                LLM-->>Worker: impl_code
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                alt GREEN passed or abort
                    break
                else
                    Cycle->>Cycle: set error_feedback
                end
            end

            alt GREEN failed
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
            else GREEN passed
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result

                alt learning enabled
                    Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                    Reflector->>LLM: generate(analysis_prompt)
                    LLM-->>Reflector: analysis
                    Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                    Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                    Curator->>LLM: generate(synthesis_prompt)
                    LLM-->>Curator: delta_bullets
                    Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                    Playbook-->>Curator: added_bullets
                    Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                end

                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=True)
            end
        end

        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        Runner->>Planner: record_test_written(...)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(...)
    end

    Runner-->>Main: IterativeResult
```
